## Problem

What's the gap or pain point? (e.g. "I can't do X, so I have to work around it by...")

## Proposed solution

What would you like to happen? If you have a specific approach in mind, describe it.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've thought about.

## Is this on the roadmap already?

Check [docs/roadmap.md](../../docs/roadmap.md) — if it's already listed, link to the relevant
section here instead of duplicating it.

## Additional context

Anything else — mockups, related issues, links.
